title: accents.jsonc
description: The accent each track gives a unit and the perks of its two levels (game design 2.3). A multiplier is what a value is multiplied by: "1.15" is 15% more and "0.75" is 25% less.

accents.description: Accents by track ID. A track without an entry gives no accent.

name.description: The accent's display name, such as Overgunned. Not empty, and no space at either end.

level_1.description: Perks at level I: the track is one tier ahead of the chassis.

level_2.description: Perks added at level II: the track is two tiers ahead. A unit at level II has the perks of both levels.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

number.description: A whole number, or text in plain decimal notation such as "2.6". A bare number with a fraction is not accepted, so that every value is read exactly.

perks.description: Perks by kind. A kind may appear only once in the whole file.

range_bonus.description: Range times the multiplier, which is at least 1. For a chassis with a ranged attack.

attack_rate_bonus.description: That many times as many attacks in the same time; at least 1. "1.15" is 23 attacks in the time of 20. For a chassis with a melee attack.

splash.description: Every hit also deals a share of its damage to each other enemy near the target. For a chassis whose attack has no blast.

share.description: The share of the hit's damage, above 0 and at most 1.

radius.description: How far from the target, in tiles.

blast_radius_bonus.description: Blast radius times the multiplier, which is at least 1. For a chassis whose attack has a blast.

area_damage_reduction.description: Area damage taken times the multiplier, which is above 0 and at most 1.

plating.description: Damage taken times the multiplier, above 0 and at most 1, when the attacker's effective Firepower is below this unit's effective Protection.

charge.description: The first attack after moving far enough deals more damage. For a chassis with an attack.

distance.description: Tiles moved since the last attack.

multiplier.description: What that attack's damage is multiplied by; at least 1.

batch.description: Each queue slot produces two units.

time_multiplier.description: The pair's build time, as a multiple of the build time of one unit.

death_refund.description: Part of the Materials paid for the unit is refunded when it dies.

share.description: The share refunded, above 0 and at most 1.

regeneration.description: The unit regains hit points once per second after a time without damage.

share_per_second.description: The share of maximum hit points regained each second, above 0 and at most 1.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds without damage before it starts. It must be a whole number of ticks.

minimum.description: The least a unit can cost.
